notes: rng_namespace, not version, seeds the layout and sensor RNGs: a v0.x bump that keeps it keeps every layout and noise draw.
window [onset, release): the impairment is on for observation indices onset <= t < release (reset is t=0); release null = to the end.
range/hemifield/blind are known impairments: valid=0 and the value forced to 0. noise is undetected: values flip inside the valid field, valid stays 1.
hemifield sides are the body's, under the current heading; the midline column (right == 0) stays valid.
blind keeps heading and last-action outcome (contact); only the local grid goes.
rates in noise are per cell per step: blocked_flip flips the blocked bit, beacon_drop hides a true beacon, beacon_spurious shows one where there is none. The agent's own cell is never noised.
condition 6 (out-of-distribution obstacle structure) and task B (cue direction) come in v0.2.
